lines: An installed app keeps the version it loaded. Now it offers each new one, between rides.
When a new version is deployed, the app offers it the next time it opens: a toast with Reload. It stays until the rider chooses.
During a race, class or custom ride, the offer waits, and nothing reloads. When the ride ends, the toast appears.
The spec runs the real service worker and deploys a new version. Take away the ride's hold, and it fails.
The offer, from a phone to the full screen.
Telo Ride, from the Telo family, turns a smart bike at home into a game.
It pairs with the bike over Bluetooth, reads your power and sets resistance for every hill and interval.

lines.text: Two doors: Race, ride a map against your best-time ghost, bots or people; and Classes, ride along to a video, alone or with a group; fed by one progression of XP, rider levels, stars and map unlocks.
